 Anthropic-backed pro-AI safety nonprofit Public First Action's PACs spent $25M+ in 12 states to help elect eight of the 13 House and Senate candidates it backed   —  As discussions of AI regulations accelerate, Anthropic spent the past year pouring money into groups that spent big on the U.S. midterm elections.
